optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Product Operations Manager, After-Sales Service Network

professionalSummary.text: Product Operations Manager with 3 years of experience owning operational readiness for after-sales service network product releases, leading partner onboarding programmes, and managing weekly readiness reviews with cross-functional stakeholders.
professionalSummary.witness: Responsibilities included release readiness ownership, onboarding programme leadership, readiness reviews and escalation for the after-sales network product over three years.

experienceHighlights.text: Owned operational readiness sign-off for six product releases, documented in release tool with name and date, with product manager approving scope and head of product operations informed.
experienceHighlights.witness: Held the operational readiness sign-off for six product releases; the sign-off record in the release tool carries my name for each release, with the product manager approving scope and the head of product operations informed.

experienceHighlights.text: Led partner onboarding programme for dispatch product across two regions, including development of training materials and onboarding schedule, with partner readiness sign-off before go-live.
experienceHighlights.witness: Led the partner onboarding programme for the dispatch product across two regions, owning the onboarding schedule and the training materials and signing off each partner's readiness before their go-live date.

experienceHighlights.text: Chaired weekly readiness reviews with partner support and regional service leads, recording decisions and owners in review log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Chaired the weekly readiness review with partner support and the regional service leads, recording decisions and owners in the review log.

experienceHighlights.text: Escalated two unresolved readiness risks (partner training backlog, warranty-claim mapping) to head of product operations with recommended resolutions, both resolved before release.
experienceHighlights.witness: Escalated two unresolved readiness risks (partner training backlog, warranty-claim mapping) to the head of product operations with a recommended option each; both were resolved before release.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Readiness sign-off records for two releases exported from release tool (release, readiness items, sign-off name, date) and onboarding schedule for one region with tool audit history as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the readiness sign-off records for two releases exported from the release tool (release, readiness items, sign-off name and date) and the onboarding schedule for one region, with the tool's audit history as a verification trail.

skills.text: Operational Readiness Management, Partner Onboarding Leadership, Cross-functional Stakeholder Coordination, Risk Escalation & Resolution
skills.witness: Responsibilities included release readiness ownership, onboarding programme leadership, readiness reviews and escalation for the after-sales network product over three years.

evidence.text: Held the operational readiness sign-off for six product releases; the sign-off record in the release tool carries my name for each release, with the product manager approving scope and the head of product operations informed.

Led the partner onboarding programme for the dispatch product across two regions, owning the onboarding schedule and the training materials and signing off each partner's readiness before their go-live date.
Chaired the weekly readiness review with partner support and the regional service leads, recording decisions and owners in the review log.
Escalated two unresolved readiness risks (partner training backlog, warranty-claim mapping) to the head of product operations with a recommended option each; both were resolved before release.
Responsibilities included release readiness ownership, onboarding programme leadership, readiness reviews and escalation for the after-sales network product over three years.
